CustomField.formula:
IF(LEN(TEXT(MONTH(DATEVALUE(EndDate)))) > 1, TEXT(MONTH(DATEVALUE(EndDate))), '0' + TEXT(MONTH(DATEVALUE(EndDate)))) + '/' +
IF(LEN(TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE(EndDate)))) > 1, TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE(EndDate))), '0' + TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE(EndDate)))) + '/' +
TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(EndDate))) + ' ' +
IF(VALUE(MID(TEXT(EndDate + ((1/24) * -4)), 12, 2)) >= 12, IF(VALUE(MID(TEXT(EndDate + ((1/24)* -4)), 12, 2)) = 12, "12", TEXT(VALUE(MID(TEXT(EndDate + ((1/24) * -4)), 12, 2)) -12)), MID(TEXT(EndDate +((1/24) * -4)), 12, 2)) + ":" + MID(TEXT(EndDate ), 15, 2) + IF(VALUE(MID(TEXT(EndDate + ((1/24) * -4)), 12, 2)) >= 12, " PM", " AM")
CustomField.label: End Date - Custom
